title.narrative: In 2024, UNICEF enhanced school practices in Greece by implementing innovative educational solutions, such as the Akelius digital language course, and supporting marginalized students through targeted materials, teacher training, and mentoring schemes. Key initiatives included skills workshops for refugee adolescents and nutrition toolkits, promoting equitable learning, life-skills, and well-being.
